packaged_transaction_assertions: an accepted unverified interactive update extracts a synthetic MAIN and preserves its bytes unchanged
accepted unchanged-stock fallback creates no Filter 2 runtime-control snapshot
successful shutdown removes the temporary preparation runtime
declining unchanged-stock fallback exits with status zero and removes the temporary runtime
a malformed update fails extraction and removes the temporary runtime
the exact verified OS 1.72 digest still enables Filter 2/LFO2
the bundled QEMU, photographic native-Tk UI, runtime drawer, and diagnostic path remain valid
local_transaction_assertions: missing sources are rejected before temporary-directory allocation
the verified-digest path creates the runtime-only candidate and exact 108-byte control snapshot
an explicit command-line digest mismatch remains strict and rolls the runtime back
--keep-runtime is the only tested preparation-failure retention override
safety_boundary: All transaction fixtures are synthetic and non-proprietary. The packages contain no Elektron firmware. Filter 2/LFO2 remains restricted to the exact verified OS 1.72 MAIN digest; other valid updates can only take an explicitly confirmed unchanged-stock path.
scope_limit: This gate proves first-launch preparation and rollback logic executes inside both frozen macOS architectures and that both resulting artifacts pass the existing structure, architecture, signature-seal, and firmware-exclusion audit. It does not boot a proprietary update during CI, prove compatibility with every Elektron release, provide Apple Developer ID notarization, or validate physical hardware.
